projects.title: Fetal Distress Risk Stratification from Cardiotocography
projects.headline: Explainable 3-Tier Fetal Compromise Triage
projects.summary: Explainable three-tier fetal risk stratification (Normal / Suspect / Pathological) from 21 cardiotocography features using class-weighted LightGBM and 5-fold stratified cross-validation.
projects.challenge: Clinical CTG cohorts suffer from severe class imbalance (only 8.3% Pathological), where false negatives risk fetal compromise and black-box predictions lack obstetric trust.

projects.title: AutoVisCheck: Intelligent EDA & Audit Platform
projects.headline: Automated EDA & Misleading-Chart Risk Scorer
projects.summary: Interactive Streamlit web application guiding users through cleaning, column-type-aware visualization, automated statistical interpretation, and exportable HTML/Markdown reporting.
projects.challenge: Manual exploratory data analysis is prone to irreversible cleaning mistakes and visually deceptive chart configurations (e.g., truncated axes or unnormalized group comparisons).

projects.title: Explainable ML for Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR)
projects.headline: Ciprofloxacin Resistance Prediction in E. coli
projects.summary: End-to-end clinical machine learning pipeline predicting fluoroquinolone non-susceptibility in Escherichia coli using longitudinal hospital mass-spectra metadata (2015â€“2018).
projects.challenge: Raw clinical susceptibility registries contain 41 co-tested antibiotic outcomes that induce severe shortcut learning if not systematically purged prior to gradient boosting.

projects.title: Sepsis Survival XAI: Calibrated Mortality Benchmark
projects.headline: Platt-Calibrated In-Hospital Sepsis Mortality
projects.summary: Reproducible benchmark predicting in-hospital sepsis mortality from minimal clinical records using imbalance-aware XGBoost, sigmoid calibration, and patient-level SHAP waterfall audit trails.
projects.challenge: Standard cost-sensitive boosting (scale_pos_weight) heavily distorts predicted probabilities on 7.35% mortality cohorts, requiring post-hoc Platt scaling on a dedicated validation split.

projects.title: Pediatric Immunization Surveillance & Dropout BI
projects.headline: Global WUENIC Vaccine Trajectory & Dropout Suite
projects.summary: Star-schema Power BI analytics platform and SQLite relational ETL pipeline tracking childhood immunization coverage, DTP1-to-DTP3 retention bottlenecks, and COVID-19 delivery shocks.
projects.challenge: Global WHO/UNICEF registries are distributed across fragmented wide-format Excel matrices, requiring automated unpivoting and DAX measures to isolate pandemic-era coverage drops.

projects.title: SARS-CoV-2 Genomic Variant Clustering via k-mers
projects.headline: Alignment-Free Viral Clade Discovery
projects.metricHighlight: ~30,000 SARS-CoV-2 Genomes  |  341 k-mer Features  |  Log2 Fold-Change
projects.summary: Unsupervised genomic clustering of ~30k viral sequences using 1- to 4-mer frequency spectra, PCA dimensionality reduction, MiniBatchKMeans, and XGBoost motif importance.
projects.challenge: Multiple sequence alignment across tens of thousands of full viral genomes is computationally expensive; k-mer frequency spectra enable rapid alignment-free motif profiling.

projects.title: Real-Time CNN Face Recognition Pipeline
projects.headline: Live Video Facial Feature Extraction & Classification
projects.metricHighlight: End-to-End Custom Dataset  |  OpenCV + TensorFlow CNN
projects.summary: Constructed a custom labeled facial dataset, applied OpenCV spatial preprocessing, and trained a convolutional neural network for real-time identity inference on live video streams.
projects.challenge: Maintaining low-latency frame rates and classification stability under varying ambient lighting and camera angles during live webcam inference.

projects.title: Cart Crush: Retail & Financial Inventory ERP
projects.headline: Relational Retail Management & Document Automation
projects.metricHighlight: C# .NET Framework  |  SQL Server  |  Automated Receipts
projects.summary: Full-featured retail management platform integrating normalized SQL Server operations, inventory tracking, financial record auditing, and automated email/receipt generation.
projects.challenge: Ensuring transactional consistency across concurrent inventory updates, billing calculations, and automated receipt dispatch.
